posts.zh:
dsh-single-instance-guard 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ea87cc0844450af18a3e.html
posts.en:
dsh-single-instance-guard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ea87cc0844450af18a3e.html
